versions.changelog:
- Initial release providing end-to-end inspection guidance for fresh and frozen pig offal based on GB/T 9959.4-2019.
- Supports compliance checks for sensory, physical-chemical, and microbiological indicators.
- Includes detailed workflows for sample classification, source verification, sampling schemes, and judgment rules.
- Offers usage examples, standard-based grading, and non-compliance reinspection procedures.
- Strictly enforces the use of standardized terminology and reference to regulatory documents.
